scope: Companion planning checklist, not a new dataset record type or production scoring configuration.
current_readiness: Coverage and synthetic arithmetic can be checked; real analyses require verified eligible observations and their gates.
common_gates: Pin lawful upstream release, native identifiers and ordered transformations before considering new collection.
Verify source provenance, exact revisions, actor/model identity and duplicate/translation lineage.
Pass frozen v0.1 contract and exact unit checks without adding fields or statuses.
Pass recipe-specific semantic comparability and temporal eligibility checks.
Specify analysis units, dependencies, missingness, uncertainty and sensitivity rules.
Freeze and review the analysis specification before held-out evaluation; obtain separate publication approval.

recipes.name: Compare benchmark performance
recipes.estimand: Performance change on a declared task distribution under a fixed evaluation protocol.
prerequisites: Exact model version or narrowly qualified provider label.
Same benchmark/task release, split, metric, harness, prompt/scaffold, tools and inference budget, or validated bridge.
Declared time axis, date precision, panel and contamination strata.
analysis: Matched fixed-panel differences by capability dimension.
Bounded scores: absolute percentage-point change and elapsed-time slope; relative change/error reduction only when meaningful.
Positive ratio scales: endpoint annualized change; any time-trend fit is separately specified and validated.
outputs: Per-dimension series and contributing run IDs.
Protocol breaks, selected-best versus fixed-panel panels, exclusions and paired/cluster-aware uncertainty.
stop_if: Metric scale does not justify proposed rate.
Evidence cannot support claimed generalization beyond observed tasks.

recipes.name: Measure resources and efficiency
recipes.estimand: Change in an explicitly bounded resource, or resources required for fixed performance under a fixed protocol.
prerequisites: Measurement phase, hardware, precision, utilization and reported/measured/estimated class.
Native currency, price date, billing denominator and any reproducible conversion.
Lineage for benchmark-imputed compute to detect circular association.
analysis: Separate comparable physical-resource and monetary series.
Observed fixed-performance resource frontier with stated interpolation limits.
outputs: Native and transformed values, assumptions and uncertainty.
stop_if: Cost boundaries, units or currencies are not comparable.
Benchmark-inferred compute would be treated as independent evidence for the same relation.
forbidden_conclusions: Compute growth alone identifies capability or harm growth.

recipes.name: Compare safety and harms
recipes.estimand: Protocol-specific safety-evaluation outcome or recorded event frequency within a defined observation process.
prerequisites: Matched threat model, evaluator effort, mitigations and rubric for safety tests.
Event-level deduplication with separate involvement, verification and causation.
Exposure and ascertainment model before reporting an incident rate.
analysis: Within-protocol safety comparisons.
Counts of reviewed events separately from reports, allegations and near misses.
Exposure-based rates only when denominator and reporting assumptions are defensible.
outputs: Test conditions, threshold definitions and uncertainty.
Reporting lag, event IDs, revisions and exposure limits.
stop_if: Laboratory findings would be pooled with deployed harms.
No exposure denominator for a rate claim.
forbidden_conclusions: Zero observed failures means zero risk.
Incident count scaled to extinction probability.

recipes.name: Compare adoption observations
recipes.estimand: Adoption or economic change for a defined population, question and reference period.
prerequisites: Survey population, instrument/wave, design weights, reference periods and uncertainty.
Documented breaks in wording, sampling, sector coverage or collection mode.
Cross-country concept/denominator alignment before comparison.
analysis: Within-series changes first.
Separate regimes at unsupported breaks.
Side-by-side qualified descriptions when quantitative harmonization is not defensible.
outputs: Population, sample/exposure denominator, weighting and breaks.
stop_if: Administrative registrations would be labelled capability gains.
Incomparable national measures would be ranked on one scale.
forbidden_conclusions: Observed association identifies causal productivity effect.
Current deployment and intention to adopt are identical.

recipes.name: Describe beliefs and revisions
recipes.estimand: Distribution or revision of attributed forecasts among a declared selected group answering an exact question.
prerequisites: Same outcome, population, condition, horizon, units and answer semantics.
One active estimate per person/question under declared as-of and withdrawal rules.
Survey aggregate attributed to a wave-specific collective, with separate aggregator and sampling context.
analysis: Distributions and medians only for compatible shapes and questions.
Matched-person change separately from entry/exit composition.
Preserve intervals, bounds, quantiles and qualitative records without invented point values.
outputs: Exact question revision, eligible/contributing people, exclusion reasons and estimate age.
stop_if: Missing horizons or differing conditions would be silently pooled.
Publisher would be substituted for anonymous respondents.
forbidden_conclusions: Purposive corpus is global expert consensus.
Speaker count is a confidence interval on event probability.

recipes.name: Reconstruct historical information
recipes.estimand: Information admissible at a declared cutoff, or separately labelled authenticated retrospective evidence.
prerequisites: Exact revisions and closed dependencies with truthful known_at and represented review times.
Conservative precision-aware forecast-time eligibility.
Explicit distinction between current-corpus chronology, as-known snapshot and retrospective reconstruction.
analysis: Select active eligible revisions without counting audit history as independent events.
Forward-time and related-event-family holdouts.
Separate late-discovered pre-outcome published forecasts from strict as-known backtests.
outputs: Snapshot/manifest identity, cutoff, timing mode and excluded records.
Timestamp authentication, survivorship/discovery bias and leakage audit.
stop_if: Later labels, transformations or corrections leak into earlier claims.
forbidden_conclusions: Date filtering removes all hindsight leakage.

recipes.name: Evaluate resolved forecasts
recipes.estimand: Forecast performance on a prespecified eligible resolved question set and forecast-origin rule.
prerequisites: Exact question revision, admissible forecast and human-reviewed resolution evidence.
Separate origins, deadlines, resolution times and evaluation cutoffs.
Same event set, lead times/origins, weighting and missing-forecast rules for method comparisons.
Prespecified baseline and uncertainty/dependence design.
analysis: Brier loss for eligible resolved binary point probabilities.
Baseline-relative skill only for nonzero baseline loss.
Reliability and discrimination separately; shape-specific scoring for nonbinary forecasts requires another reviewed protocol.
outputs: Case and forecast counts, exclusions, score, baseline and dependence-aware uncertainty.
Frozen statuses open/resolved/ambiguous/void; unmet conditions explained in rationale or exclusion context.
stop_if: Future deadline, ambiguity or missing follow-up would become a false binary outcome.
Inadequate informative cases/clusters for the intended claim.
Score would bypass deliberately disabled public scoring.
forbidden_conclusions: Human survival gives repeated independent extinction trials.

scenario_boundary: One-pathway conditional chain-rule identity only; no probabilities supplied, causal model fitted, or total harm probability identified.
publication_boundary: Private acquisition and analysis do not authorize public publication or activation of scoring.
